steps.text: 3:59 P.M. \ Cloudy
Nomadic Town Wolumonde, Infected Quarter, Zwölftontechnik Strasse

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic... Are you angry?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The way they were acting, I know what it means. I know it all too well...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But... But Atro wouldn't get herself into trouble. She knows Leithanien better than any of us!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yeah! I'm sure she's fine!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: At least, I hope...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Isn't this place eerily quiet?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes. Stay close.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm seeing plenty of Infected among the citizenry, but that's not the main point.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I was thinking about it when we fought those rioters before. This residential district is pretty ordinary in design, isn't it?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They've just gathered up all the Infected to live together. There's nothing explicitly discriminatory about it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But the truth is they're still having their personal freedom restricted. And aside from a few remarkable Infected, most people live more or less like prisoners.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What they have is not a prison, but an entire street of cells with a dozen times more inmates.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Look here, how long do you think it's been since this bakery was open?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Ew... I think I saw an Originium slug crawling around... so unsanitary.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No one's been sweeping up the dust and leaves around the door. There's no functioning economy here. No daily life.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I understand they've fallen on hard times, but no one wants to buy or sell bread? There's no public transit? This isn't normal.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Maybe, maybe it's because of what happened before? Like the shop owner got scared off or something?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: At least they have the right to live, they—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Shh! Miss Folinic...! Lower your voice!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I wasn't criticizing them. I was just talking about... those 'armed Infected.'

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Do you think they're...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That policeman mentioned 'Sarkaz.' We need to look into that first.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If they do have anything to do with the 'armed Infected groups' we know, we'll have to tread carefully. Things here may be far more complicated than that policeman knows.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If the Infected are living well enough, it's only because the situation isn't desperate enough.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: They must be hiding something from us.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Please don't worry. Atro is very smart.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You've been looking very scary since that meeting. But don't worry.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: As long as we try really, really hard, we'll be able to handle this, just like the senior operators!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: So can you relax for me? At least a bit?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Aw, is little Lisa comforting me again? Why's that?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hehe, let go of all your troubles, big and small!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Doctors, please wait a moment—!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Didn't I say we don't need any help? All we need is access...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I'm sorry. I know you said as much, Miss Folinic, but considering the circumstances, and your unfamiliarity with this place, we have to take precautions to guard against potential accidents.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: ...Miss Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Fine... The locals may be more welcoming if we have one of their own with us.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: That's true! *Cough cough*! Zwölftontechnik Strasse was once Wolumonde's biggest Infected quarter...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And now, for certain reasons, it's become Wolumonde's number one protest district.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Then what do you plan to do now?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I don't think it's wise to go any deeper into this place... But if you want to learn more about the situation in Wolumonde, that is a good choice.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's just go for a stroll here. No need to rush things.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'd be very happy if you were willing to tell me more about Dr. Atro.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: You... really worry about Dr. Atro, don't you?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We went to school together. And she is one of my very few trusted friends. Not to mention an employee Rhodes Island can't afford to lose.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Ah, please come this way. Schaukelplatz is just up ahead.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What was Atro doing here?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Um... Treating the local Infected, giving psychological counseling to those who were suffering.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Wolumonde was unable to avoid the Great Rift because of an error the Catastrophe Messengers made, and we suffered immensely for it.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Dr. Atro could have left, but she decided to stay. After Wolumonde moored here, she set up a temporary medical facility to better serve the Infected.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Dr. Atro... is their hero.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...She was just doing what she had to do.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She's always been better at practical work than rote learning.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Heh. I can see her face right now, looking so self-satisfied. That's Atro.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: This is the first time you've smiled since coming to Wolumonde.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Is it?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You've been pretty scary all day long, Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: There's... a lot of people up ahead. Is that where everyone is?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Shouldn't you do something?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Peaceful assembly isn't a crime. That alone isn't grounds to detain them.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They're looking this way...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Why is everyone quiet all of a sudden?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No, this isn't right... Who's that talking to them?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Behind them, in the very back, there's—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A Sarkaz...?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Sarkaz...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know! They're coming at us! Hey, you, protect yourself!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: O-okay!
